definitionZh: CSS 的挂号属性指定了在文本行的起始或结尾处应当挂号。 悬浮标注可置于线框外.
sourceDefinition: The hanging-punctuation CSS property specifies whether a punctuation mark should hang at the start or end of a line of text. Hanging punctuation may be placed outside the line box.
